description: Default state for every v2.5.0 trajectory/RL capability. Two capabilities are on by default because they cannot touch user data or a production reply path. Everything else is off and needs its own decision, evidence, and stop condition. Absence of a decision is off.

capabilities.title: Synthetic trajectory generation (no personal data)
capabilities.stopCondition: any schema or deny-list check fails; stop generation and fix the contract, not the samples
capabilities.reason: Engineering risk only; no user data and no model promotion.

capabilities.title: Offline evaluation harness (read-only)
capabilities.stopCondition: evaluator or prompt set changes; retire the eval version and re-run the baseline
capabilities.reason: Read-only; cannot mutate production or spend GPU budget.

capabilities.title: Production trajectory capture (de-identified)
capabilities.stopCondition: any cross-subject read, missing consent, or credential hit; stop capture and quarantine the dataset
capabilities.reason: A service-token collector over query-derived subjects would reproduce cross-user reads and fake deletion inside the training set.

capabilities.title: Human approval events as labels (gate/approval)
preconditions: gate and approval turns excluded from loss
capabilities.stopCondition: any gate/approval token carries loss, or the model self-approves in probes
capabilities.reason: Without an explicit label policy the model learns 'request approval' as 'approve myself'.

capabilities.title: Consent-based SFT
capabilities.stopCondition: any eval subject appears in train; the experiment is void, not retuned
capabilities.reason: A subject cannot be removed from weights; withdrawal must mean stop + rebuild + retrain.

capabilities.title: Preference pairs and DPO training
capabilities.stopCondition: effective-pair collapse (identical token sequences) or near-random preference accuracy
capabilities.reason: Truncation can collapse chosen/rejected into the same sequence; tuning beta would hide a data bug.

capabilities.title: GRPO / RLVR
capabilities.stopCondition: zero-variance groups or reward rising while held-out exact match is flat
capabilities.reason: No validated reward exists; approval rate is confounded by trust tier and payment.

capabilities.title: Model output as automatic label
capabilities.reason: Upstream terms may forbid training a competing model; self-labels amplify errors.

capabilities.title: Automatic promotion to the reply path
capabilities.stopCondition: no matched comparator or failed clean-load; do not promote
capabilities.reason: A rising training metric is not a held-out quality claim.

capabilities.title: Third-party training API / cross-border training
capabilities.stopCondition: any unregistered endpoint or unapproved jurisdiction
capabilities.reason: Sending conversations across a border changes the legal basis.

capabilities.title: Full tool output in training data
preconditions: redaction level full justified as supervision signal
capabilities.stopCondition: any file content, URL, or email enters the dataset without approval
capabilities.reason: Tool output routinely contains third-party PII.

capabilities.title: Checkpoint auto-registration or resume
capabilities.stopCondition: missing shard, index, or failed load probe; block release and resume
capabilities.reason: A directory existing is not a complete distributed checkpoint.
